messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "screening result"
set: ["screening result", "can cause false-positive result on urine screening tests for benzodiazepines", "routine drugs-of-abuse screening", "false positive drug screening test (amphetamines)", "false-positive result can continue for several days after stopping", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening at regular intervals", "inform laboratory staff about taking the medicine during drug screening", "screening for personal or family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania", "ask doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting and at regular intervals afterwards", "test results", "results of certain medical tests", "having imaging test with contrast dye", "drug-screening urine test", "false results on drug-screening urine test", "can affect the results of certain medical tests"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
